intent: Read a discussion topic while browsing another user's replies.
actions: Open another user's public Replies activity stream at a 1280×720 desktop viewport, with enough replies to require loading another batch, and wait for the initial batch to load.
Scroll beyond the initial replies, wait for more replies to load, and pause with a reply from the newly loaded batch visible.
Open the topic title link beside that reply and wait for the topic to load.
Use browser Back to return to the Replies stream and wait for loading to settle.
